content.comment_body: I am able to run my program from the PC while using the device with IP: 192.168.1.90. However, when I try to connect via the mobile app, I encounter a 'Connection refused' error. I am using a router with IP: 192.168.1.101 and a [product_name] BM [article_no]. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user can successfully run their program from a PC, but receives a 'Connection refused' error when attempting to use the mobile app. This indicates challenges with remote connectivity and inconsistent access between PC and mobile platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to access the [product_name] device reliably from both their PC and mobile app, without experiencing connection issues.
